![AGS Certification: Everything to Know Before You Buy a Diamond](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09171306-2330-0066-0000-12d989bbcfbf:4)
The American Gem Society (AGS) grading system is `a scientific, performance-based method famous for pioneering precise diamond cut and light evaluation`.[[1]](https://www.whiteflash.com/certified-diamonds/)[[2]](https://www.usajewels.com/education/about-diamond-certification/ags)

### The AGS 0–10 Numerical Scale

- **0 (Ideal):** The highest grade, indicating top-tier light performance and optical symmetry.
- **1 (Excellent) & 2 (Very Good):** High-quality cuts with minor proportion variations.
- **3–4 (Good) & 5–7 (Fair):** Average cuts with noticeable light leakage.
- **8–10 (Poor):** Suboptimal proportions that significantly reduce brilliance.[[1]](https://www.whiteflash.com/diamond-education/ags-cut-grading/)[[2]](https://www.usajewels.com/education/about-diamond-certification/ags)[[3]](https://www.diamondsourceva.com/education/certification/diamonds-ags-certification.asp)[[4]](https://www.markschneiderdesign.com/blogs/jewelry-blog/ags-vs-igi-diamond-certification-which-one-is-better)

### Key Features of AGS Grading

- **Light Performance (ASET):** AGS uses ray-tracing technology and the Angular Spectrum Evaluation Tool (ASET) to measure brightness, fire, and contrast.[[1]](https://www.usajewels.com/education/about-diamond-certification/ags)[[2]](https://www.whiteflash.com/gia-vs-ags/)
- **Fancy Shapes:** Unlike traditional labs that restrict advanced cut grading to round stones, AGS applies its scientifically vetted light performance system to fancy shapes like princess and oval cuts.[[1]](https://www.whiteflash.com/ags-vs-gia/)[[2]](https://www.whiteflash.com/certified-diamonds/)
- **Current Status:** AGS Laboratories operations transitioned, and the [AGS Ideal Report](https://www.gia.edu/ags-ideal-report) is now administered through a collaboration with the Gemological Institute of America (GIA).[[1]](https://www.gia.edu/ags-ideal-report)[[2]](https://www.pricescope.com/education/ags-diamond-certification)

If you'd like, let me know:

- What **shape** of diamond you are looking at
- Whether you are comparing **AGS vs. GIA** reports
- Your **budget or target size** 

I can help you evaluate which certification fits your priorities best.
